We see crimes being committed. We see people defrauding the government. And too often, it seems like no one is held accountable.

As a Member of Congress, we get a front-row seat to all of it. When we tried to subpoena Ilhan Omar and her brother/husband's immigration records, it was Republicans who blocked it. Both parties always protect each other.

Video

INTRODUCING: The FETCH Act to expand and reinforce how law enforcement agencies can use existing federal grant funding to support K-9 units.

Police K-9 units are one of the most effective tools in law enforcement and keeping our communities safe.

MACE WIN: Over the past five years, we’ve helped thousands of constituents, closing 13,253 cases and counting.

Whether it’s VA issues, passports, or tax returns, our office is here to help with any federal agency.

South Carolina STRONG.

I want an Attorney General who will make arrests, who will prosecute, and who will put criminals in jail.

And I want ALL the Epstein files released. 

No more two-tier system of justice.

Pam Bondi will soon leave her job as the Attorney General.

My subpoena still stands. When the Oversight Committee moved to subpoena Bondi, I did it by name, not by or not as the sitting Attorney General of the U.S.

RELEASE THE EPSTEIN FILES.

BREAKING: Attorney General Pam Bondi FIRED.

Bondi handled the Epstein Files in a terrible manner and seriously undermined President Trump.

She has stonewalled every effort to hold the guilty accountable. The American people deserve an Attorney General who is transparent and delivers real accountability.

We look forward to a new Attorney General who is committed to getting justice for the victims of Jeffrey Epstein.

If the reports that Lee Zeldin will be replacing Pam Bondi as Attorney General are true - I welcome it.

Bondi handled the Epstein Files in a terrible manner and made this situation far worse than it had to be for President Trump.

I look forward to a new Attorney General committed to getting justice for the victims of Jeffrey Epstein.

We met with the family of our constituent, Johnny Wactor, who has been selected as a 2026 Citizen Honors Award Honoree for his heroic actions and selfless sacrifice when he lost his life shielding a co-worker from an armed robber.

The Congressional Medal of Honor Society recognizes only five citizens a year, nationwide to receive the Citizen Honors Awards. This distinction is reserved for those who choose courage over comfort and service over self.

Truth. Justice. Transparency.

The Epstein survivors deserve every one. What they’ve gotten are delays and cover-ups.

We won’t stop until they get the answers they deserve.

Article II, Section 3 of the Constitution gives the President the authority in extraordinary circumstances to the convene both houses of Congress, or either of them.

The longest government shutdown in American history of the Department of Homeland Security during an elevated threat environment certainly would qualify as extraordinary.

The Senate has been derelict in its responsibilities. President Trump should immediately move to convene the Senate pursuant to Article II, Section 3 until they
The 14th Amendment was never intended as a loophole. The Supreme Court must get this right.

The SAVE America Act is a historic chance to secure our elections and ensure only American citizens vote in American elections, yet the Senate refuses to get it done. Instead of sending this bill to President Trump’s desk to have it signed into law, they took a two-week break.

Call your Senators’ offices and ask why.

Video

Walking away should never be an option when national security is on the line. The Senate did it anyway.

Article II, Section 3 exists precisely for moments like this. The President has the authority to call the Senate back and he should use it. Keep them there until every dollar of DHS is fully funded.

The Senate can take a recess when the country is safe. Right now, they need to do their jobs.

READ MORE HERE: mace.house.gov/media/press-r…

MACE WIN: We've helped return $38,763,190 to the constituents of SC-01.

Our casework team works around the clock with federal agencies like Social Security, the IRS, and the VA to make sure constituents get every dollar they’re owed.

South Carolina STRONG.

We want the truth.

The women and children abused by Jeffrey Epstein deserved protection. They didn't get it. Not from the justice system, not from the institutions meant to serve them. Every sealed file and redacted name protects abusers at the expense of victims.

It's time to expose these predators for what they really are.
Should child rapists receive the death penalty?

A week ago Lindsey Graham was ready to sacrifice the lives of 7,000 marines invading Kharg Island. This week he wants to end the war.

I'm always ahead of the curve. Some people just take longer to catch up.


Dominic Michael Tripi (@DMichaelTripi)

NEW: Lindsey Graham now encouraging Trump to “wind down” the Iran war and facilitate peace efforts in a drastic shift from earlier messaging repeatedly insisting Trump escalate the conflict.
